riskFactors: Revolutionary and experimental VFX requirements (slit-scan, front projection)
Complex and large-scale set construction (rotating centrifuge, space station)
Seasonal restrictions for location shooting (Africa dry season)
Extensive and high-risk stunt work (animal interaction, zero-g)
Extremely long makeup application times (ape, aging)
Multiple cast availability conflicts and specific restrictions
High budget and extended production timeline

executionSequence.description: Dispatch initial data packets to agents for parallel processing of compliance rules and resource availability.
Consolidate responses from Phase 1 and dispatch the complete, constrained model to the Optimization Agent.

dataFlowValidation.complianceResponse: Must provide a machine-readable set of hard and soft constraints (e.g., turnaround times, meal penalties).
dataFlowValidation.logisticsResponse: Must provide a comprehensive availability matrix for all critical resources (cast, locations, special equipment).
dataFlowValidation.interAgentConsistency: Ensure cast members flagged for stunts by Compliance Agent are cross-referenced with stunt performer availability from Logistics Agent.

qualityChecks: Verify 100% union turnaround and meal break compliance in final schedule.
Confirm all weather-dependent scenes are scheduled within seasonal windows.
Analyze Day-Out-of-Days report for cast efficiency and holding day minimization.
Validate location groupings to ensure minimal company moves.
Ensure contingency days are allocated appropriately.
